audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 and Levels 4-5 were marked the wrong way round against the already-audited mirror; Level 2 was given to Gangplank while his own page calls it even.
audit.why: gangplank__neeko records Level 1 = Neeko 4/10, Level 2 = Skill 5/10, Levels 4-5 = Gangplank 6/10. Mine must state the same facts inverted, or mirror-fix.js overwrites them.
audit.corrected: phases[0]/win[0] Skill -> Neeko (rating 5/10 -> 6/10), phases[1]/win[1] Gangplank -> Skill, phases[3]/win[3] Skill -> Gangplank. Proposed as one atomic group, both layers paired.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike was sold on a mechanic Neeko does not have (W invisibility).
audit.why: Riot's text for Neeko W is a third-attack proc plus a directional clone; there is no stealth in it and the kit carries no stealth flag. The real concealment is Inherent Glamour (P), which hides the Pop Blossom preparation.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4], mid and wants.you[1] now credit the disguise, and state that the hidden wind-up is what makes the ult land.

audit.why: Remove Scurvy curing crowd control is explicit in Riot's text, so 'cleanses your root' is supported; a stun that has already resolved cannot be undone by it, which the page already teaches. Added its 22s rank-1 cooldown so the bait is timeable.
audit.corrected: W cooldown numbers added to mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cannon Barrage deals true damage and neither layer said so; late told the player his crits beat 'your shield and W', which also implies absorption Neeko does not have.
audit.why: Kit flags trueDamage on Gangplank R: stacking MR is the wrong answer to it. Flagged in _missing for this matchup.
audit.corrected: late rewritten to name the true damage and drop the phantom shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Remove Scurvy's healing is mentioned repeatedly but Grievous Wounds timing never reaches the late-game text.
audit.why: _missing flags needs-antiheal for this matchup; extended trades are decided by whether anti-heal is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The enemy ability is written throughout as 'Powder Kegs (Barrels)'. The real name is Powder Keg (singular, no parenthetical).
audit.why: Kit file is authority on names.
audit.corrected: Corrected where the length band allowed; several occurrences are inside strings I could not shorten without losing content — listed in notes.

edits.before: Neeko has no combo at Level 1 and only single-target Q value, but Gangplank also can't barrel-burst yet, so neither of you owns it — it's a farm-and-setup stand-off.
edits.after: You out-range him at Level 1: Blooming Burst reaches 800 while Parrrley only reaches 625 and his barrel chain isn't online yet, so the first health bar tilts your way.

edits.before: Pop Blossom off a disguise/W-invis setup lands a stun his W can't cleanse after the fact — your one even-or-better window, so neither side is locked out.
edits.after: Pop Blossom out of a disguise lands a stun Remove Scurvy can't undo after the fact — your one even-or-better window, so neither side is locked out.

edits.before: Pop Blossom off a disguise or W-invis setup is your one clean kill window — land E, ult unseen, and his W cleanse can't undo a stun he never saw coming.
edits.after: Pop Blossom out of a disguise is your one clean kill window — the wind-up is hidden, so land E, ult unseen, and Remove Scurvy can't undo a stun already on him.

edits.before: Reach Level 6 and set up Pop Blossom from disguise/W-invis so he eats the stun before his W cleanse is relevant
edits.after: Reach Level 6 and set up Pop Blossom from a disguise so he eats the stun before Remove Scurvy is ever relevant

edits.before: Level 6 is your single best moment: Pop Blossom set up from a disguise or a W (Shapesplitter) invis lets you land E and slam down a stun he never sees, and a stun that already landed can't be cleansed by his W. Bait his W out with a Q poke or a fake-commit first — once Remove Scurvy is on cooldown, your E root actually sticks and your full combo connects. Through Levels 4-5 you're farming even-to-behind, so don't all-in without ult; wait for the 6 window or a barrel mistake and convert hard, because this is the last stretch where you're stronger than he is.
edits.after: Level 6 is your single best moment: set Pop Blossom up while disguised and the preparation is hidden, so you land E and slam a stun he never sees — and a stun already on him can't be cleansed. Bait Remove Scurvy out with a Q poke or a fake commit first; it is down 22s at rank 1, and in that window your E root sticks and the full combo connects. Through Levels 4-5 you're farming behind, so don't all-in without ult; wait for the 6 window or a barrel mistake and convert hard, because this is the last stretch where you're stronger.

edits.before: This is where the lane gets away from you. Gangplank is a hard scaler — once he hits Trinity Force and 2+ items his barrel chains crit your squishy body for more than your shield and W can absorb, and his global R lets him affect fights you're not even in. Your single rotation can't outlast his sustain-and-crit package the way it did at 6. Play for your team here: roam with disguise pressure, look for E picks on his carries in fights rather than dueling him, and pray you already took your lead before the game went long.
edits.after: This is where the lane gets away from you. Gangplank is a hard scaler — once he hits Trinity Force and 2+ items his barrel chains crit your squishy body outright, and Cannon Barrage is true damage on a global range, so no amount of MR reduces it. Remove Scurvy heals through your chip, so buy Grievous Wounds before you plan any burst. Play for your team here: roam with disguise pressure, look for E picks on his carries rather than dueling him, and take your lead before the game goes long.

edits.before: Trade right after he commits Powder Kegs (Barrels)
edits.after: Trade right after he detonates a Powder Keg chain

edits.before: That is Gangplank’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Trial by Fire plus barrel crits win auto wars — don't audition.

notes: 'Powder Kegs (Barrels)' is the wrong ability name and it appears in roughly a dozen strings (focus.text, loading, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0..2], report[1], report[5], report[9]). I only corrected the ones where a same-length replacement kept every fact intact; the rest would need either a shorter string than the ±10% band allows or content dropped to pay for the extra words. A find/replace of 'Powder Kegs (Barrels)' -> 'Powder Keg' across this matchup would fix them all at once and is worth doing outside the band check. Second point: Gangplank E has no cooldown in the kit (0) — it is charge-based, so 'wait for its cooldown' advice anywhere on this page is structurally wrong; the real punish window is the arming delay on a freshly placed keg, not a cooldown.
